payload.headline: Agent failed immediately due to JSON parse error in LLM output, scoring 0/10.
what_went_wrong: LLM output was wrapped in markdown code fences (```json ... ```) which caused JSON parsing to fail before any API calls were made.
No API calls were executed at all — the agent crashed at the planning/initialization stage.
Both scoring checks failed (0/2) resulting in a 0.0 normalized score with no partial credit.
what_to_try_next: Fix the LLM output parser to strip markdown code fences (```json and ```) before attempting JSON.parse, or instruct the LLM to return raw JSON without fences.
Add a retry/fallback mechanism: if JSON parsing fails, attempt to extract JSON from the response using regex before giving up.
Ensure the system prompt explicitly instructs the LLM to return ONLY raw JSON with no markdown formatting or code blocks.
